content.short: Vana is a modular Layer 1 blockchain for user-owned AI, allowing individuals to monetize their personal data easily.
content.description: Vana is a pioneering decentralized Layer 1 blockchain network specifically engineered to return ownership of personal data to individuals and transform it into a productive asset for the AI era. Originating from research at MIT, the platform enables users to pool their private data—such as social media history or health metrics—into "DataDAOs" (Data Liquidity Pools). These DAOs then selectively license high-quality datasets to AI researchers and developers, with contributors earning ownership and rewards in the resulting AI models, ensuring fair compensation for user-powered intelligence.
